title: Allgemeinen Transformationsterm interpretieren
description: Die lernende Person kann den Term $g(x)=a\cdot f(b\cdot(x-c))+d$ als Kombination von Verschiebung, Streckung beziehungsweise Stauchung und Spiegelung deuten, auch ohne konkret gegebenen Funktionsterm von $f$.
checks: Viewed the complete actual raster, including the parameter cards and ordered example.
For g(x)=a f(b(x−c))+d, c>0 shifts right, d>0 shifts up, a controls vertical scaling/reflection, and b≠0 controls horizontal factor 1/|b| and reflection. All stated rules are correct.
The example −2f(0.5(x−3))+1 correctly maps (u,v) to (2u+3,1−2v). Its stated sequence of transformations gives that same mapping.
The image explains the general term without requiring a concrete function f, matching the current goal.
